core.title: 15 Inch Black Iron Push Plate, Acorn RMLBP

text.description_html:
Acorn RMLBP, Rough Black Iron 15" Push Plate

This hearty 15 inch push plate gives an old world charm to any home door. It will match well with heavy wood doors. It will surely add a great weathered feel to any door because the rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals and imitates the natural weathering of iron. Since it is made by Acorn, it has a lifetime no rust warranty.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Specifications of the Rough Black Iron Door Push Plate:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 15"
  • Width: 3-5/16"
  • Thickness: .070
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Sold individually. Package includes 1 push plate and hardware for a surfaced mounting application. All dimensions are approximate.
